title: Genesis 2:2 — Sabbath: God ended his work and rested on the seventh day
summary: Genesis 2:2 in English under the heading Sabbath (with 'bbath' in red) and the Hebrew reference בראשית ב:ב. Words are colour-coded: God has three colours, 'his work which He had made' is coloured the same way in both lines, and 'rested' is partly red. No Hebrew verse text is shown.

text.text: And on the seventh day God ended his work which He had made; and He rested on the seventh day from all his work which He had made.

numbers.note: the seventh day on which God rested

uncertain: The meaning of the many text colours is not explained on the slide
